industry_text_en: Construction of residential and non-residential buildings

briefing.text: VEIDEKKE ENTREPRENØR AS (org. 984024290) is a private limited company in Oslo, founded in 2001, working in construction of residential and non-residential buildings; its registered purpose (in Norwegian) is «Drive entreprenørvirksomhet, samt annen økonomisk virksomhet, herunder deltakelse i andre selskaper ved aksjeinnskudd eller på annen måte».
In FY2025 it reported revenue of NOK 16.2 billion and an annual result of NOK 727.8 million, revenue rose 2.4% from 2024.
It has 13 registered workplaces, in Bergen, Gloppen, Gol and 6 more.
A public procurement award dated 21 Sep 2026 names it as supplier for "COUNTY ROAD 552 Hatvik and Venjaneset ferry quays - Expansion of the ferry quay".
No company website could be verified.
No active job ads were found in the checked sources.

supporting_detail.text: VEIDEKKE ENTREPRENØR AS is based in Oslo and registered under Construction of residential and non-residential buildings (NACE 41.000), with 2925 registered employees and NOK 16,185,659,000 in revenue in FY2025.
